data.name: Lokita
data.long_meaning: Lokita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'loka' meaning 'people'. The name signifies the goddess who protects and nurtures her people. In Hindu mythology, Lokita is a form of the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. She is believed to bring happiness and good fortune to her devotees.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lokita carries a deep cultural significance as it is linked to the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is revered as the embodiment of material and spiritual wealth. The name represents the belief in a protective and nurturing deity who looks after her people and bestows abundance and prosperity upon them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lokita represents the idea of selfless service to the community and greater good. It serves as a reminder that each one of us has a role to play in the well-being of those around us and that we are all interconnected in the larger scheme of things. Additionally, the name signifies the importance of nourishing and caring for others, just as the goddess Lokita is believed to care for her people.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lokita is mentioned in the Mahabharata as the name of a Yaksha queen. The name Lokita carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
